name: Meet Thakkar
heroDescription: Passionate developer exploring the intersection of web technologies, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. Building innovative solutions that make a difference.

experience.description: Specialized in high-performance Rust backend systems, real-time media communication protocols, and system-level desktop automation for an Enterprise Interaction Platform. Completed intensive training in advanced Rust systems engineering, including Tokio async runtime, Axum web frameworks, WebSockets, and WebRTC protocols. Developed unified chat (with TiKV distributed persistence and MinIO media storage), multi-user video calling via LiveKit SFU, and a secure host Windows control agent to bypass browser sandboxes.
highlights: Specialized in high-performance Rust systems engineering, including ownership, lifetimes, and multithreading concurrency under the Tokio runtime and Axum web frameworks.
Engineered robust WebSocket & WebRTC backend signaling servers to negotiate peer session SDP Offer/Answer and ICE Candidates dynamically.
Integrated distributed TiKV key-value databases for message history and MinIO S3-compatible storage for secure enterprise file transfers.

experience.description: Worked as a Software Developer Intern, building and optimizing AI-driven shopping assistants, natural language processing models, real-time media tools, and marketing systems. Designed and developed backend modules and user interfaces for high-performance applications.
highlights: Built a RAG-based shopping chatbot integrating Amazon Bedrock (Anthropic Claude), Pinecone DB, and Next.js.
Restructured the backend and developed the frontend editor for a natural language to SQL (NL2SQL) module.
Developed both backend and frontend for a Virtual Try-On feature enabling real-time camera overlays.
Created and maintained landing pages with HubSpot forms and lead conversion tracking.
